div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: 三轨并发审核明细

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
硬性时效/规则不满足
且无质量故障证据

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
关键凭证缺失
(如漏水/坏果未传清晰照片)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 买家补充凭证

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 买家主动撤回 / 超时未补

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
小额(<=5000分即50元) + 三轨全通过
+ confidence>=0.85 + fallback_used==False

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
大额(>5000分) 或 规则冲突
或 confidence<0.85 或 fallback_used==True

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
主管在 Vue 3 审批页操作
POST /api/v1/claims/{no}/confirm
触发 Command(resume=...)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: REJECT (驳回申请)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: REQUEST_EVIDENCE (退回补材料)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
APPROVE / MODIFY_AMOUNT
(强制校验修改金额 <= max_refundable_cents)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 200 OK (含幂等重放成功)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 网络超时 / 5xx 异常

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
START: 收到售后申请单 claim_no
写入 PG claim_tickets (SUBMITTED)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
load_order_and_policy 节点:
1. 校验订单快照与可退上限 max_refundable_cents
2. 调用 EcomRAG (:8002) 检索对应品类有效期内售后条款

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: run_three_tracks 节点 (asyncio.gather 节点内三轨并发)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
轨道 1：时效与状态规则轨 (纯规则无 LLM)
核验签收天数、是否支持7天无理由、可退余额上限

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
轨道 2：问题描述与凭证归因轨
结合买家凭证、文本与 EcomNLU 辅助信号
评估是否属实质量问题并记录 confidence / fallback_used

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
轨道 3：条款算费与优惠分摊轨
按实付占比分摊公式核算建议退赔分值 suggested_refund_cents
及退货入库策略 (可售仓 vs 次品仓)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
aggregate_and_route 节点:
汇总三轨结论与风险等级

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 条件路由边: route_after_audit

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
auto_reject 节点:
状态置为 AUTO_REJECTED
通知 C 端买家驳回原因

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: END

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
request_more_evidence 节点:
状态置为 NEED_MORE_EVIDENCE
通知买家限时补充材料

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 买家补齐凭证或主动撤回?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
状态置为 WITHDRAWN
通知 EcomPilot 恢复订单为 FULFILLED

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
auto_approve 节点:
写入本地 PG 审批通过与 outbox_events
生成唯一 refund_idempotency_key

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
notify_supervisor 节点:
标记高风险复核原因并推送待审列表

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
supervisor_review 节点:
调用 LangGraph interrupt() 挂起工作流!
状态快照持久化至 AsyncPostgresSaver (PostgreSQL)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 判断主管恢复指令 action

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
apply_supervisor_decision:
状态置为 SUPERVISOR_REJECTED
同步结果至 EcomPilot

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
apply_supervisor_decision:
同一 PG 事务写入审批结论与 outbox_events
状态置为 APPROVED_PENDING_CALLBACK

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
execute_refund_callback 节点:
先检查 step_execution_id 防止节点重入重复调用
调用 EcomPilot POST /internal/v1/refunds/execute

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 回调响应结果?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
更新工单状态为 COMPLETED
标记 outbox_events 已完成

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
状态置为 CALLBACK_RETRYING
交由后台 Outbox 对账协程轮询 EcomPilot 退款状态直至闭环
